offer_price_range.name: offer_price_range
offer_price_range.value: ("offer"."unit_amount_minor" is not null and "offer"."unit_amount_minor" between 1 and 10000000) or ("offer"."unit_amount_minor" is null and "offer"."kind" = 'service' and "offer"."requires_scope_review")

offer_digital_needs_asset.name: offer_digital_needs_asset
offer_digital_needs_asset.value: "offer"."kind" <> 'digital' or not "offer"."published" or ("offer"."digital_asset_id" is not null and "offer"."access_days" between 1 and 3650)

quote_totals_valid.name: quote_totals_valid
quote_totals_valid.value: ("quote"."subtotal_minor" is null and "quote"."total_minor" is null) or ("quote"."subtotal_minor" is not null and "quote"."total_minor" is not null and "quote"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "quote"."total_minor" >= "quote"."subtotal_minor")

quote_payable_has_total.name: quote_payable_has_total
quote_payable_has_total.value: "quote"."status" not in ('review_ready', 'accepted', 'consumed') or ("quote"."total_minor" is not null and "quote"."total_minor" > 0)

seller_question_lengths.name: seller_question_lengths
seller_question_lengths.value: char_length("seller_question"."question") between 1 and 500 and char_length("seller_question"."customer_goal") between 1 and 500 and ("seller_question"."answer" is null or char_length("seller_question"."answer") between 1 and 1000)

shop_guide_action_pair.name: shop_guide_action_pair
shop_guide_action_pair.value: ("shop_guide"."action_label" is null and "shop_guide"."action_url" is null) or ("shop_guide"."action_label" is not null and "shop_guide"."action_url" is not null and length("shop_guide"."action_label") between 1 and 60 and length("shop_guide"."action_url") between 1 and 1500 and "shop_guide"."action_url" like 'https://%')
